title: FDA Flowcharts

origin.publisher: U.S. Food and Drug Administration (CDRH and CBER)
origin.title: Deciding When to Submit a 510(k) for a Change to an Existing Device: Guidance for Industry and Food and Drug Administration Staff (October 25, 2017)
origin.clearance_note: FDA guidance document, a work of the U.S. federal government published on fda.gov for general use. The operator extracted pages 2, 13, 17, 25 and 34 of the 78-page original (the cover and the four decision flowcharts) and supplied that file locally. Each page's text was checked identical to the corresponding page of a fresh download from the URL above. PDF metadata cleared. No personal data: the only contact details are FDA office phone lines.

notes: No feature page or fields were requested; the request asked only that pages 2, 13, 17, 25 and 34 of the original be used. Page 5 (Flowchart C: Materials Changes) is featured because it is the one chart whose logic ADE extracted without error, and the featured fields trace its only route to a new 510(k): C4 (new biocompatibility concerns?) Yes, then C4.1 (same material in a similar marketed device?) No, then New 510(k). Each flowchart parses as a single FLOWCHART figure block with one grounding box, so every value read from inside a chart grounds to the whole chart: three of the four crops are the same image. Only the caption, a separate text block below the figure, grounds tightly. Extraction errors on the other charts are recorded in the README.
